scholarships.title: UZH Student Financial Aid Office – Scholarships

existing.description: The Swiss Study Foundation supports highly talented students by providing network opportunities and scholarships: Swiss Study Foundation
eligibility: We only support first degree programmes at every level of study. (And we do not support PhD study programmes.)
existing.eligibility_summary: First-degree programmes only. International Bachelor's students: eligible after earning 55 ECTS credits. International Master's students: eligible only if they hold a Swiss Bachelor's degree. Parents' taxable income must not exceed CHF 86,000 (net worth under CHF 300,000). All other financing sources must be exhausted.
application_method: The entire application process is handled via an online portal.
In the portal, you can upload documents and track the current status of your application .
If an application is submitted successfully, you will receive a confirmation by email .
Do you have questions about the decision, submitting an application, submitting enclosures, data protection? You may also find our FAQ - UZH scholarships, loans & applications helpful.
Approvals or rejections will also be communicated directly via the portal.
existing.duration: Per semester or academic year, depending on financial need and progress.
